title: OpenAI Japan announces Japan Teen Safety Blueprint to put teen safety first
summary: OpenAI Japan announces the Japan Teen Safety Blueprint, introducing stronger age protections, parental controls, and well-being safeguards for teens using generative AI.
body: OpenAI Japan announces the Japan Teen Safety Blueprint, introducing stronger age protections, parental controls, and well-being safeguards for teens using generative AI.
summaryZh: OpenAI 日本发布了青少年安全蓝图，旨在加强对青少年用户的保护措施。该内容主要关注合规与社会责任，与模型技术研发无直接关联。

aiReview.reasonZh: 属于公司政策与合规性公告，不涉及模型技术本身。
